headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 12, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Sandy Alcantara pitched a strong 8 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs. The Seattle Mariners also had a dominant performance, defeating the Washington Nationals 10-2 behind Bryce Miller's 8.0 innings of work.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Texas Rangers center fielder Evan Carter, who is out with a right oblique strain. The Pittsburgh Pirates' Wilber Dotel has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right lat muscle strain, while the Detroit Tigers' Jack Flaherty is out with a left peroneal strain.

The Cleveland Guardians made a roster move, trading RF Nolan Jones to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations. The Milwaukee Brewers traded RHP Jacob Waguespack to the Detroit Tigers.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured an 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Sandy Alcantara pitched a strong 8 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory. Bryce Miller led the way on the mound, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Shane Baz earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Torkelson's Homer Not Enough as Tigers Fall to Guardians**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers came up short in a 2-3 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with Spencer Torkelson leading the Tigers' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Rangers CF Evan Carter Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Evan Carter has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Cleveland Guardians Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for future considerations on June 11, 2026.
